<ic>Add the following to the declaration of Sorcery: A declared Sorcerer is barred from knowingly interacting with eternals and their heralds.<br><br>Proposed by Zenith, seconded by Kahraman.</ic>

===Overview===
* Amend the law to prohibit interaction with a herald or eternal by any individual declared a sorcerer by the Conclave.

===Date===
* Spring Equinox 378YE

===Campaign Outcome===
* The [[Declaration#Declaration of Sorcery|Declaration of Sorcery]] was amended.
